question: Can I change step free from Waterloo and City to Northern at Bank entirely underground?
original_answer: Yes. The step-free interchange between the Waterloo & City and Northern lines at Bank involves about 290 metres via street and lifts, so it is not entirely underground. The Waterloo & City lift route uses Walbrook, Monday to Friday. This describes the interchange route, not platform-to-train boarding or current lift availability.
corrected_answer: No. The step-free interchange between Waterloo & City and Northern/DLR at Bank involves about 290 metres via street and lifts. The Waterloo & City lift route uses Walbrook, Monday to Friday. This does not establish current lift availability or gap-free boarding.
